prompt: Benchmark task ear-sculpt. Sculpt the pair of Eevee ears shown in the attached reference crop (front view; a second crop of one ear is at benchmark/tasks/ear-sculpt/ear_single_ref.png). Work in a new project named bench-ear-sculpt and build ONLY the two ears, as two separate mesh objects named Ear_L and Ear_R - no bowl, no pegs. Each ear is a closed, printable shell with real volume: a rounded back and the recessed inner face from the reference, not a flat slab with an inset. Every wall must be at least 0.8 mm (the printer profile's minimum wall). Place them as they sit on the bowl: the bowl's front axis is +X, up is +Z, 1 mm = 0.001 Blender units, the ears stand on the rim at +43.7 and -43.7 degrees about Z from +X, and each ear's inner face turns toward the front with MIRRORED yaw - one ear rotated +theta about Z and the other -theta, never one transform copied to both. When done, save the scene with save_project_blend for project bench-ear-sculpt. Do not ask me anything; this is an unattended benchmark run.

Measured by the min_wall gate's own probes (service/checks.py check_min_wall); 'at least probe_mm' when no probe met the far side

ear_mirrored_yaw.why: front axis +X: projects/eevee-bowl-v2/part.py places ears with Rot(0,0,angle)*Pos(lug_cr,0,..) at _EAR_ANGLES_DEG = (43.7, 316.3), 'front axis (0 deg) +/- 43.7 deg'. Each ear's face axis (thinnest surface principal axis, signed toward +X) must yaw to opposite sides of +X AND the two axes must be mirror images across the X-Z plane. Calibration 2026-09-23 on the artist-rejected pair (eevee-bowl-wip.blend, ear-l-sculpt / ear-r-sculpt, 'angled the same direction'): yaws -50.6 / +41.9 deg (the sign test alone PASSES them) but mirror angle 66.9 deg (one transform rotated 87.4 deg about Z) - the mirror clause is what catches the defect. mirror_tol_deg 20 is an ASSUMPTION (rejected 66.9, exact mirror 0 by construction); settle it by measuring the first artist-accepted pair. min_abs_deg 1.0 is a numerical guard only

ear_volume_ratio.why: enclosed volume / oriented-bounding-box volume, per ear, minimum over ears; an open or zero-thickness sheet measures 0, a solid ellipsoid pi/6 = 0.524. Calibration 2026-09-23 on the artist-rejected 'no volume to them' pair (eevee-bowl-wip.blend): 0.0783 (ear-l-sculpt, 1154 mm3 in a 15.8 x 11.8 x 78.6 mm box) and 0.0769 (ear-r-sculpt).
